# Vendored libraries

These files are loaded only by React lessons (the in-browser React lab):

- `react-19.2.8.js` bundles React 19.2.8, React DOM 19.2.8 and `react/jsx-runtime`
  (development build, so learners see React's warnings). React is MIT licensed,
  Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates. https://github.com/facebook/react
- `typescript-6.0.3.js` is the TypeScript 6.0.3 compiler, used only to turn JSX into JavaScript
  in the browser. Apache License 2.0, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
  https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript
